note: Guides are our own words, built from the official trophy descriptions and the PSN targets on the sources above. The game released 2026-11-19 and no community walkthrough existed yet when this guide was written: where the official description names no place or step, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, then activities and collectibles, and leave the long grinds (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles) for the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so just play through it — the trophy pops when the mission ends. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss; it is the first step of the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Play the story in order and it comes naturally.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Keep playing the story in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 3. It pops at the chapter's end, as part of normal story progress.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale — keep following the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold. Finish the final mission and the credits roll with this trophy. Before the finale, do the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) — your partner is with you during the story, and that is the easiest time to get them.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play the mission Breakfast Run to its end. It is a named story mission, so it comes up as you follow the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play The Cartel Heist to its end. Heist missions are story beats — follow the story and it pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play the mission Child's Play to its end. It arrives as part of the story, in order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play the mission Headliners to its end. Another named story mission — it comes with normal progress.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play the mission VCIA Takedown to its end. The airport mission — follow the story to reach it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to its end. A named story mission, reached by playing the story in order.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold, and the longest grind in the list. 100% completion means the story plus stranger strands, activities and collectibles — nearly every other trophy in this guide feeds the same counter. Do it last: when the completion counter hits 100%, this pops, and the platinum follows right after. Check the in-game stats page to see which category is still short.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver. Every stunt counts — jumps, near misses, wheelies, mid-air tricks and long airtime all feed the same total of 250. Do not grind it in one sitting: stunt naturally while driving through the story, then finish the remainder in a fast car on open roads. The in-game stats page shows your running total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one try is enough, no win needed. Sample everything the game offers (races, fishing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and the rest) and the trophy pops after the ninth type. Use the activity trophies in this guide as your checklist.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold needs accuracy and speed together, so learn each course's target pattern on a first run before going for gold, and use the weapon you are steadiest with. A failed run costs nothing — retry a course freely until the gold lands.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. Fly a practice lap first to learn the gates, then race to win — a loss costs only time. The official description does not name the 14 locations; they are found by visiting Top Fun spots across Leonida.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count. Work through the race list across Leonida: road, off-road and water races all feed the same total of 20. Tick each win off in the tracker so you know which races are still unbeaten.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — the bigger catch wins. Take the challenge when it appears, fish patiently, and do not rush the reel-in. If the game offers better tackle, upgrade before the rematch; Cal's challenge can be retried.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade game to its end. Pick the shortest cabinet first — completion is what counts, not your score. One finished game is enough for the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Contact strand. Follow Andy's missions to the end of his chain — the trophy pops after his final mission. Stranger and contact missions appear on the map as you explore, so check in with Andy between story chapters.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Contact strand. Follow Kenton's missions to the end of his chain — the trophy pops after his final mission. Work through his strand between story chapters so it does not pile up at the end.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Contact strand. Follow Billy's missions to the end of his chain — the trophy pops after his final mission. Billy's strand is one of the contact chains to clear in the side-mission phase.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers are marked on the map — meet them, finish each strand, and count them off here. The contact trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) overlap with this count, so the stranger phase clears several trophies at once.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Contact strand. Follow Randy's missions to the end of his chain — the trophy pops after his final mission. Clear contact strands in the side-mission phase, between story chapters.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Contact strand. Follow Tyrone's missions to the end of his chain — the trophy pops after his final mission. One more strand toward the eight needed for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate once at each of the 18 spots across Leonida. Spots are spread state-wide, so fold this into exploration rather than hunting them all at once — meditate whenever you pass a spot. The official description does not list the 18 spots; use the community map once it is published and tick spots off here.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Contact strand. Follow Bret's missions until the hunt unlocks, then hunt the one unique animal he asks for. The animal is specific to Bret's strand, not random hunting — the trophy is tied to that hunt, so finish Bret's chain and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete any 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; a set is only complete when every card in it is found. The official description does not name the card locations, so use the community map once it is published and tick each set off here.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver. Use the WAiNK It action at 100 locations across Leonida. Start early and do it at every landmark you pass — it adds up fast across a full playthrough, but grinding all 100 at the end is a long walk. The in-game counter shows your running total.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges of any kind — the in-game challenge list counts them all toward the same total. Work through the easiest first; combat, driving and activity challenges all feed the 50. Check the challenge list to see which ones are nearly done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner beside you — partner availability changes across chapters. Do it while your partner is riding with you, before the finale.
trophies.guide: Needs your partner beside you and a 4-star wanted level. Build heat with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Do it during the story while your partner is riding with you — partner availability changes across chapters, so do not leave this for after the finale.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner beside you — partner availability changes across chapters. Pick three close shops and do it while your partner is with you.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping the same wanted level throughout. Pick three shops close together, plan the route in advance, and keep the getaway vehicle nearby. Like Hot Together, this needs your partner with you — do it during the story, not after the finale.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a model counts the first time you drive or enter it. Try every car, bike, boat and plane you see; rare models hide in car parks, docks and airfields. The PSN counter tracks discoveries, so check it to see how many are left.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Pick a busy firefight with enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and keep firing until five are down before it ends. A fast-firing weapon and a crowded room make this much easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport without a ticket or a flight plan — steal a plane from the runway or drive out through the airfield. Expect a wanted level on the way out, so plan the exit before you go in.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missable_note: The official description names no exact trigger — it is tied to Rhino tanks. Watch for a military or wanted-level encounter involving a Rhino and engage it.
trophies.guide: Tied to Rhino tanks, but the official description names no exact trigger — the guide cannot pin down a step the list does not give. Expect a wanted-level or military encounter involving a Rhino: get into the fight with the tank and the trophy should pop when the encounter resolves. Check the community guides once the trigger is confirmed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Go in quiet, move fast, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Night helps; if you are spotted, leave and try again another night.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver. Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — the escape is part of the trophy, not just the robbery. Plan the exit before the entry, and lose the cops after each job. Five vaults, five clean getaways.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck on the road, grab the cash, and escape. Trucks patrol set routes — wait for one on a quiet stretch, stop it, take the money, and lose the wanted level before you stop. The escape counts as much as the robbery.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you drive it — cover every road and the areas tick off one by one. Save the far corners for a dedicated road trip in the cleanup phase, and check the map for the last grey patches.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One robbery per gang — the tracker counts the gangs as the community identifies them. Operations are found by exploring gang territory; the official description does not list the nine gangs by name.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a bar with a view over Ocean Beach and enjoy it. A quiet moment trophy — do it whenever you are passing the beachfront. No grind, no fight, just the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car through the showroom's frontage and out the other side. Any showroom works; pick one with a clear run-up and a straight line through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Completion counts, not your score — follow through the whole game and the trophy pops at the end. Find the alley in Vice City and book a lane.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_note: The official description names no steps — it is tied to your partnership's public profile. Watch for a partnership milestone in the in-game phone or social feed.
trophies.guide: Tied to your partnership's public profile, but the official description names no steps — this guide will not invent one. It is most likely a follower or fame milestone for the partnership: keep building the partnership's public profile and watch the in-game phone or social feed for the milestone. Check the community guides once the trigger is confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count up to 500. Dialogue and action choices across the game all feed the same total, so play naturally, do not skip conversations, and the count climbs across the whole playthrough. It pops long before the story ends.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_note: The official description names no event — it is about failing once, then succeeding on the retry. If it has not popped naturally, replay something you failed once and clear it second try.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — fail something, then succeed on the retry. The official description names no event, so this guide will not invent one. If it has not popped by the cleanup phase, replay a mission or challenge you failed once and clear it on the second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_note: A strange world event — easy to walk past. Explore off the beaten path; it pops when the event finds you.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a random or scripted oddity out in the world. The official description names no place, so the honest advice is to explore off the beaten path: back roads, odd landmarks, night-time Leonida. It pops when the event finds you, not on a schedule.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Slow the car, lean out and swing — a quiet road with pedestrians is the place. One clean hit is enough.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Keep feeding marked bills to your contacts whenever you have them — the total accumulates across the whole game, so start early and it finishes itself by the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Big purchases count fastest — vehicles and property help, and garage purchases for Little Boxes feed this total too. It accumulates on its own; do not force it early.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save up, then buy them as they appear on the market across Leonida. Property purchases also feed Treat Yo Self, so the two trophies finish together.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Any ten count — cheap cars count the same as expensive ones, so register the cars you already own or find. Ten registrations and the trophy pops.
